items.title: The Tale of Two INC Ransom Notes: A Ransomware Timeline
items.content: In late August, an organization was compromised by INC ransomware across at least 175 endpoints. items.title: Vidar Adds Virtual Machine and Custom Stream Ciphers For String Obfuscation
items.content: Vidar is an information stealer first observed in 2018 that has continuously evolved its string obfuscation techniques to evade detection and analysis. items.title: Equation of Compromise: Anatomy of a Live npm Supply-Chain Campaign
items.content: A sophisticated six-month campaign targeting quantitative and DeFi developers through malicious npm packages disguised as legitimate mathematics libraries.
